description: This file is a shell script that defines a set of automated tests for the 'git am --interactive' functionality, using the testing framework provided by 'test-lib.sh'. It sets up patches, applies them interactively, resolves conflicts, and verifies outcomes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message, used for setting up test patches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes commands that are expected to fail, used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Feeds lines of input into subsequent commands, simulating user input.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets the current HEAD to a specific state.

methods.name: git log
methods.description: Shows commit logs with specific formatting.

methods.name: git cat-file
methods.description: Provides content of objects (like blobs) in the repository.
